description: This file defines the ZipInput class, which provides functionality to read and process ZIP archive files, including scanning for the end of central directory record, listing entries, and accessing manifest data.

classes.name: ZipInput
classes.description: A class for reading ZIP archive files, extracting entries, and accessing archive metadata.

methods.name: ZipInput
methods.description: Constructor that opens a ZIP file for reading.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the logger instance for logging.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the ZIP archive.

methods.name: getFileLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the ZIP file.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Creates a ZipInput instance and reads the ZIP archive.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ZIP entry by filename.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns all ZIP entries.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists immediate children in a directory within the ZIP archive.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the manifest file from the ZIP archive.

methods.name: scanForEOCDR
methods.description: Scans the ZIP file for the End of Central Directory Record.

methods.name: doRead
methods.description: Reads and processes the ZIP archive, extracting entries.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the ZIP file.

methods.name: getFilePointer
methods.description: Returns the current file pointer position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the ZIP file.

methods.name: readByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from the ZIP file.

methods.name: readInt
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte integer from the ZIP file.

methods.name: readShort
methods.description: Reads a 2-byte short from the ZIP file.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a string of specified length from the ZIP file.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a byte array of specified length from the ZIP file.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads bytes into a buffer from the ZIP file.
